comparison.objective: Purge air from a filled syringe while preserving the drawn-up liquid, then return and release it.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine plunger control, orientation management, bubble migration, and loss-limited fluid expulsion.
comparison.success_condition: Residual air and sample loss stay below tiered limits; syringe is returned stably and released without aspiration or drop.
comparison.reason: Tests fluid/air management and fine volumetric control rather than rigid bearing transfer and physical containment of rolling bodies.
